paras: H&R BMW G81 M3 xDrive Adjustable Lowering Springs allow you to fine tune the height of your G81 M3 Touring. This kit allows you to enjoy the benefits of adjustability you get from a coilover, whilst retaining the functionality of the OEM EDC (electric damper control).
The image is a generic H&R VTF Spring kit. Item delivered will be specific to your car model.
ft: H&R VTF Height Adjustable Lowering Springs Kit for BMW M2 G87 / M3 G80 / M4 G82
